findings.claim: No Darling of the Mob today: the most-carried name is 3 of the 8 seats in the tally and no seat filed conviction 5. An unfound mob is a finding, not a pass: the consensus sits in the style (leaders at highs), not in any one name.
findings.evidence: max nomination_count=3 (A); distinct seats=8; convictions: 4x7, 3x26, 2x15, 5x0; rs_leadership LEADER=33/42

findings.claim: Style crowding: the room is buying strength at its highs into sectors the engine itself grades as fading. 23 of 42 names sit in 'Momentum Fading — Hold, Don't Add' sectors and only 8 in 'Momentum Building — Add'. 16 of 42 are at a 52-week high.
findings.evidence: sector_trend_state Fading=23, Recovering=11, Building=8; pct_from_52w_high=0.0 on 16/42; median sma_distance_pct=8.69
findings.what_is_owed: State which names the room would still want if their sector read stays Fading.
